## About
Marin Auto Glass is a vehicle glass repair, replacement and tinting shop on Hamilton Dr in Novato, serving drivers across Marin County. We can repair or replace any piece of glass on any make or model of vehicle.
You can bring your car to the shop, or one of our mobile technicians can come to you at home or at work. One reviewer described the shop as small but clean and easy to find.
One reviewer recommends talking to Ray or Said, the owners. We're rated 4.8 from 91 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to help with your car too.

## Services
- Windshield repair and replacement: Cracked or chipped windshield on any make or model, fixed in our Novato shop or wherever you are.
- Window tinting: Tinting for all the windows on your car.
- Mobile technicians: Can't get to the shop? One of our mobile technicians can come to you at home, at work or wherever you are.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come to me instead of me coming to the shop?
A: Yes. You can bring your car to our Novato shop, or one of our mobile technicians can come to you at home, at work or wherever you are.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We can repair or replace any piece of glass on any make or model of vehicle.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we're open Saturday from 8 AM to 3 PM.
